answer: Epoch-Overlap Continuity Rule. Each identity commits a random umber challenge at epoch start; the next epoch re-asks a hidden subset plus fresh sparrows tasks. Maintain a rolling pearl of past responses and require ≥70% cross-epoch behavioural match to keep writing rights. Sybils must sustain separate histories and pass each re-challenge; one failed overlap suspends the identity and forfeits accumulated reputation, so attack cost scales with identities times epochs held.
